resources.string: Enter the IP of a prepared server. The app verifies and saves its connection settings.
Helper settings are verified and saved.
Your existing private settings are preserved. The Helper toggle and local port do not change its keys or token.
Need to prepare a new server?
SSH setup is for the server owner. It requires root access, a password, and confirmation of the SSH key fingerprint.
1. Tap Start proxy in Overview.\n2. Tap Open in Telegram and choose your app.\n3. Confirm the connection in Telegram.
The link works only on this phone. Another phone needs its own copy of TG Proxy. You can use Copy link if that is more convenient.

If everything works, leave battery settings as they are. If the connection stops when you switch apps or lock the screen, allow TG Proxy to run in the background. Its notification shows the status and lets you stop the proxy.
Samsung: open TG Proxy app settings → Battery → Unrestricted. Check that the app is not in the sleeping apps list and that background data is allowed.
Xiaomi: select No restrictions for TG Proxy battery usage and allow background autostart.
Menu names depend on your Android version. These settings allow background activity; they do not start the proxy for you.

Helper is an additional server for reaching Telegram. If everything works, you do not need it. If you have a prepared Helper, open Routes, enter its IP, and tap Connect. The app retrieves the remaining settings.

First, check that TG Proxy is running. Tap Open in Telegram again to select the current connection. If it does not recover after a network change, tap Reconnect in Overview — the port and link stay the same. If that does not help, compare Wi-Fi and mobile data. If a VPN is active, try without it when possible.
Preview checks the format on this device. Nothing connects or saves automatically.
Unsupported link or invalid parameters. Use one IP for Helper, or server, port and secret for MTProxy.
After confirmation, the app will verify this Helper through the trusted registry. The link contains no token, key, or Telegram settings.
Stop the proxy and wait for the current operation to finish before changing Helper.
Telegram will show settings for this external MTProxy. It will not become a Helper in TG Proxy. Local proxy settings and operation will stay as they are.
A local link may contain an old port or secret. Use the current settings of TG Proxy running on this phone. A link from another device is not suitable.
Start TG Proxy in Overview first.
Helper link copied — it contains only the IP
TG Proxy helps Telegram connect to the network. You do not need your own server to get started.
Keep TG Proxy running while Telegram uses this proxy. When finished, turn off the proxy in Telegram and stop TG Proxy.
No server of your own? Skip this section. SSH setup is only for an owner who wants to prepare their server.

Messages working while videos load slowly does not identify one specific cause. Try another video and another network. When asking for help, include the network, phone model, app version, and whether Helper is enabled.
The app tries several routes to Telegram. One route failing does not mean the entire proxy has failed. Check whether messages send and files load; include the journal if problems keep occurring.
Tap Copy in Journal and review the text before sharing. Do not add passwords, keys, or your connection link: it contains a secret.
